paper.title_en: New insights on mutual information in the island approach to the Page curve
paper.abstract_en: In this article, we have presented one of the very important observations, regarding the behavior of mutual information of two different sets of subsystems in the after Page time scenario. This provides us with some deep insights about the redistribution of geometrical correlation between the two different sets of subsystems on a Cauchy slice. In our earlier works, we have shown how the saturation of mutual information between two specific subsystems plays a vital role in obtaining the correct Page curve for the eternal black hole. In those works, we have shown that the mutual information between $B_+$ and $B_-$, that is, $I(B_{+}: B_{-})$, vanishes at scrambling time, which leads to the correct Page curve. That means that at scrambling time, there is no correlation between $B_+$ and $B_-$. Remarkably, it is observed that at this particular value of observer's time, the mutual information between $\mathcal{I}$ and $R$, that is, $I(\mathcal{I}:R)$, becomes singular. This indicates that the regions $\mathcal{I}$ and $R$ become maximally entangled. This provides us with a notion of the transfer of geometric correlation between different regions on the Cauchy slice. In this work, we have also provided a way to calculate the tripartite mutual information of regions $\mathcal{I}$,~$R_+$ and $R_-$, that is, $I(\mathcal{I}:R_+:R_-)$ on the Cauchy slice using the earlier results involving the bipartite regions. This is a new result which was missing in the earlier literature.

decision.selection_reason_zh: 该论文探讨了Page曲线和岛公式中互信息的关键行为，提供了关于纠缠结构的新见解，并首次计算了三方互信息。
decision.title_zh: 关于Page曲线岛方法中互信息的新见解
decision.abstract_zh: 在这篇文章中，我们提出了一个非常重要的观察，关于Page时间之后场景中两组不同子系统互信息的行为。这为我们提供了关于柯西切片上两组不同子系统之间几何相关性重新分布的深刻见解。在我们之前的工作中，我们已经展示了两个特定子系统之间互信息的饱和在获得永恒黑洞正确Page曲线中起着至关重要的作用。在这些工作中，我们已经表明，$B_+$和$B_-$之间的互信息，即$I(B_{+}: B_{-})$，在扰乱时间消失，这导致了正确的Page曲线。（同时这也表明）在扰乱时间，$B_+$和$B_-$之间没有相关性。值得注意的是，我们观察到在观察者时间的这个特定值，$\mathcal{I}$和$R$之间的互信息，即$I(\mathcal{I}:R)$，变得奇异。这表明区域$\mathcal{I}$和$R$变得最大纠缠。这为我们提供了柯西切片上不同区域之间几何相关性转移的概念。在这项工作中，我们还提供了一种方法，利用之前涉及二分区域的结果，计算柯西切片上区域$\mathcal{I}$、$R_+$和$R_-$的三方互信息，即$I(\mathcal{I}:R_+:R_-)$。这是一个新结果，在之前的文献中是缺失的。
